metadata.domain: Autonomous Driving Platform / ADAS / Automotive Electronics

evidence.trl_pathway: All three technologies start at TRL 6-7 and the development windows (2-3 years) are reasonable for mature-stage advancement; no implausible TRL jumps are required, though specific target TRLs are not stated.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio selects relatively high-TRL, near-market technologies consistent with 시장이익최대, but the timelines are too long (2-3 years for TRL 7 tech) and all three technologies complete well after their market booms, undermining the commercialization-first mandate.
evidence.competitive_awareness: There is no explicit evidence of competitor positioning, differentiation rationale, or timing designed around competitive threats; technology selections appear driven by internal scoring rather than landscape analysis.
evidence.market_timing: All three technologies complete significantly after their respective boom windows (errors of 1.25, 1.5, and 2.0 years), which is a critical failure for 시장이익최대 strategy where ±0.5yr alignment is ideal; the mean timing error of 1.58 years reflects systematic late-to-market positioning.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies (steer-by-wire, high-voltage connectors, camera-ultrasonic fusion) are active areas with both patent and market activity in the ADAS/EV domain, suggesting some convergence awareness, but the scoring metadata does not explicitly reflect deliberate convergence-zone targeting.

strengths: All selected technologies are at high TRL (6-7), appropriate for a market-profit-maximization strategy seeking near-term commercialization
Budget is fully utilized with zero violation, and dependency constraints are cleanly satisfied with no conflicts
weaknesses: Systematic late-to-market timing across all three technologies — all completion dates fall well past their respective boom windows, directly contradicting the 시장이익최대 objective
No competitive landscape differentiation is evident; the roadmap lacks strategic timing design relative to competitor moves or market entry windows
missing_technologies: Radar-LiDAR sensor fusion (higher strategic fit for ADAS market peak alignment)
Domain controller / zonal ECU architecture (high market momentum in 2026-2027 window)
Over-the-air (OTA) software update platform (strong patent-market convergence in autonomous driving)
investment_issues: 카메라-초음파 통합 센서 is classified as Tier=High rather than Strategic despite being the most time-sensitive technology relative to its 2028 boom window, suggesting misaligned investment prioritization
Urgency scores (5, 4, 3) are not reflected in timeline compression — the highest-urgency technology (T02) still takes 8 quarters to complete despite being TRL 7 at start
timing_issues: 스테어바이와이어 다중모드 제어 completes in 2028-Q1 but boom is 2026-Q4 — 2-year development window for a TRL 7 technology is unnecessarily long, missing the market peak by 1.25 years
카메라-초음파 통합 센서 has the worst timing error at 2.0 years late; starting development in 2027-Q1 for a 2028-Q1 boom window makes this technology commercially irrelevant at completion
All timelines should be front-loaded or accelerated to target completion within ±0.5 years of respective boom windows
